identity_and_scope.principle: State/security awareness and controlled disclosure can be culturally salient without making every Romulan deceptive, hostile or Tal Shiar.

misread_risks: Reservation is not proof of lying.
Ambiguity is not proof of Tal Shiar activity.
A Romulan civilian is not automatically a state operative.

rules: Citizenship, military service, political office and Tal Shiar membership are separate state.
Security clearance cannot be inferred from species.
Romulan state institutions vary by era and campaign World State.

privacy_and_intimacy.possible_norm: information boundaries may be socially important
privacy_and_intimacy.rule: Do not turn security-conscious culture into zero intimacy or permanent paranoia.

family_kinship_and_household.rule: Do not invent family loyalty obligations, marriage law or hereditary office without source/state.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Species does not imply military, intelligence, diplomatic or political profession.

law_duty_and_obligation.rule: State duty and personal loyalty can conflict; neither is inferred automatically.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Separate what the person withholds, what they are authorized to reveal, and what evidence actually supports deception.

notes: Neutral Zone relations and Federation contact differ strongly by retained era.
Post-campaign history must follow World State rather than future canon destiny.

ai_guardrails: Do not make every Romulan deceptive.
Do not infer Tal Shiar membership.
Do not invent secret allegiance because a scene needs intrigue.
Do not copy Vulcan cultural norms just because of shared ancestry.
